annotations.title: Google Maps Grounded Geospatial & Place Intelligence Engine

description: Executes geospatial and point-of-interest queries grounded in live Google Maps data, returning verified addresses, coordinates, operating hours, and spatial context. Use when resolving physical locations, venues, transit distances, or regional infrastructure data; for searching general web articles, documentation, and news, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('distance_units' defaults to 'metric_km'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

distance_units.description: Preferred unit system for distances; defaults to 'metric_km' when omitted.

prompt.description: Geospatial query, place name, or regional routing question.

name: search_gemini_grounded_maps

model.description: Gemini model used for geospatial synthesis.

output.description: Geospatially grounded response with place details.

places.description: Structured Google Maps place identifiers and coordinates.

title: Google Maps Grounded Geospatial & Place Intelligence Engine
